pageDescription: Choose the nickname others see when you take part in the stream's activities. No account needed.
pageIntro: A nickname is the name others see when you take part. You do not need one to vote: pick one only if you like.
pseudoHelp: {min} to {max} characters: letters, digits, spaces, dashes. Example: Red-Moon.
needScript: To continue, turn on JavaScript in your browser.
forgetText: Your browser keeps a random private code; the site keeps only a scrambled version of it and your nickname. This button erases everything, on this site and in your browser.
pm_net: That could not be sent. Check your connection then try again.
pm_limit: Too many tries at once. Wait a minute then try again.
pm_busy: The site is busy. Try again in a moment.
pm_invalid: That could not be taken into account. Reload the page then try again.
pm_unknown_room: This space does not exist (any more).
pm_room_full: This space has reached its maximum number of people.
pm_muted: You cannot change your nickname right now.
pm_pseudo_short: This nickname is too short: {min} characters at least. Example: Red-Moon.
pm_pseudo_long: This nickname is too long: {max} characters at most. Make it shorter.
pm_pseudo_chars: Use only letters, digits, spaces and dashes, starting with a letter or a digit. Example: Red-Moon.
pm_pseudo_banned: This nickname is not allowed here. Choose another one.
pm_pseudo_taken: This nickname is already taken. Choose another one, for instance by adding a digit.
pm_unknown_participant: Reload the page then try again.
liveIntro: During your live, open the address below **on your phone**: you get big buttons to start, stop or move to the next one, and to mute someone or clear a room. Prefer to keep everything within reach in OBS? Add the **dock** just below: same buttons, in a small panel.
qrAlt: Code to scan with your phone to open the remote control
dockSteps:
The dock is the same remote control in a small panel you place inside OBS: the same buttons, with a mouse or a keyboard.

1. Copy the dock address below.
2. In OBS, open the **Docks** menu, then **Custom Browser Docks**.
3. Type a name (for example "Audience"), paste the address, then click **Apply**.

The panel appears: put it wherever you like. You can also open this address in a browser tab.
dockOpen: Open the dock in a tab
remoteSecret: These addresses are secret (the phone and the dock share the same key): anyone who knows one of them can use the buttons. Do not share them; if someone saw them, create new ones below. Scan the code with your phone to open it without typing anything.
regenConfirm: Yes, the previous addresses (phone and dock) will stop working
regenHelp: Do this if someone else saw one of the addresses. You will then need to reopen the remote control on your phone and paste the new dock address in OBS.
remoteNoRight: You are not allowed to see the secret address of the remote control or of the dock. Ask the owner of the site.
pluggedNone: No module plugs into the remote control yet. Activity modules (like Polls) add themselves as soon as they are installed.
suggestReason: adds its buttons to the remote control (for example to start poll rounds)
limitsTitle: What Audience guarantees, and what it does not
limitsText: There is no account: a person is recognised thanks to a private code kept in their browser. Someone who clears their data, changes browser or uses private browsing is therefore seen as a new person. The site slows down abuse (limits per connection, unique nicknames, forbidden words) but cannot stop all of it. Inactive participants are erased after {days} days. For anything that matters (prize draws, contests), do not rely on these protections alone.
moderateNoRight: You are not allowed to moderate rooms. Ask the owner of the site.
roomsIntro: A room is the space of one activity (for instance the polls). You can mute someone in it or clear it. The words not allowed in nicknames are set at the bottom of this tab.
noRooms: No room yet. They appear by themselves when someone takes part.
confirmClear: Clear this room? Everyone in it will be forgotten and will have to join again.
confirmRemove: Remove this person from the room?
journalIntro: Who decided what, and when (remote control presses, mutes, rooms cleared, round winners). Lines older than 30 days are erased.
errRight: You are not allowed to do this. Ask the owner of the site.
okRegen: New address created. Reopen the remote control on your phone and paste the new dock address in OBS: the previous ones no longer work.
remoteFoot: Secret address: do not share it.
remoteNoPanels: Nothing to drive yet. Install an activity module, like Polls.
remoteErrNet: That did not go through. Check your connection.
remoteErrGone: This item no longer exists. The remote control will refresh.
remoteErrFailed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
remoteErrInvalid: That gesture was not understood. Reload the page.
remoteErrLimit: Too many presses at once. Wait a few seconds.
drawIntro: Let one person win among those who sign up from your stream chat, from a page of your site, or both. Open the draw, let people sign up, close it, then draw. During the live, the buttons "Open the draw", "Close" and "Draw a winner" are also on the remote control and in the OBS dock. Sign-ups are erased 24 hours after closing.
drawNoRight: You are not allowed to manage the prize draw. Ask the person who owns the site.
drawNone: No draw yet. Create one below, in "New draw".
drawSumKeyword: In the chat: {keyword} (who can sign up: {level}).
drawSumUntilClosed: Sign-ups stay open until you close the draw (48 hours at most).
drawPageAddress: Address of the sign-up page (to share)
drawFPickCountHelp: From 1 to 10. A person already drawn cannot be drawn again. You do not need to close the draw first: drawing closes it.
drawNewBlocked: A draw is open: close it before creating a new one.
drawFTitleHelp: Shown on screen and on the sign-up page. Example: Gift of the day.
drawFKeyword: Word to type in the chat (optional)
drawFKeywordHelp: With or without the exclamation mark: "!gift" and "gift" are the same. Leave empty for a draw without chat.
drawFLevel: Who can sign up from the chat
drawFLevelHelp: Only about the chat. The site is open to everyone.
drawFSiteHelp: Yes: a page of your site lets people sign up with a nickname (one sign-up per browser).
drawFMinutesHelp: From 1 to 120. Leave empty: the draw stays open until you close it (48 hours at most).
drawFWinnersHelp: From 1 to 10. This is the number drawn by the buttons of the remote control and the dock.
drawClearConfirm: Yes, erase the sign-ups and the people drawn
drawClearHelp: The settings of the draw and its state (open or closed) stay. This cannot be undone.
drawRedrawConfirm: This person can no longer be drawn and another one will be drawn instead. Continue?
drawPeopleIntro: Only the administration team sees this list: 50 people per page, newest first. It is erased 24 hours after the draw closes.
drawPurged: The list was erased, 24 hours after the draw closed.
drawRemoveConfirm: Remove this person from the draw?
drawRemoveMuteConfirm: Remove this person from the draw and stop them from taking part again?
drawScreenHelp: To show the person or people drawn on screen for 20 seconds: in OBS, add a browser source with the address below. Do you build an overlay page? Add the "Prize draw" element in the Overlays section: it also shows the draw in progress (title, word to type, number of sign-ups).
drawScreenSecret: This address is secret: do not share it. If another person saw it, create a new one below (the old one will stop working).
drawKeyConfirm: Yes, the old screen address will stop working
drawKeyHelp: You will need to paste the new address in OBS.
okDrawKey: New address created. Paste it in OBS: the old one no longer works.
drawScreenIncomplete: Incomplete address: copy it again from the Audience administration, "Prize draw" tab.
drawErr_title_empty: Write a title. Example: Gift of the day.
drawErr_title_long: This title is too long: 60 characters at most. Shorten it.
drawErr_kw_invalid: Write a single word, without spaces, with letters or digits. Example: !gift.
drawErr_minutes_invalid: Enter a number of minutes between 1 and 120, or leave empty. Example: 15.
drawErr_winners_invalid: Enter a number between 1 and 10. Example: 1.
drawErr_no_way: There must be at least one way to sign up: a word for the chat, or sign-up from the site. Example: word "!gift".
okDrawRemovedMuted: Person removed from the draw and muted.
drawErrAlreadyOpen: A draw is already open. Close it first.
drawErrNone: There is no draw. Open one first.
drawErrEmpty: There is nobody left to draw.
drawErrGone: This person or this draw no longer exists.
drawErrReopen: This draw cannot be reopened: create a new one.
drawErrFailed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
drawOpenConfirm: The previous draw will go to the history
drawCloseConfirm: Nobody will be able to sign up any more
drawPickConfirm: The result will show on screen
drawPageDescription: Sign up for the stream's prize draw with your nickname. No account needed.
drawPageIntro: Sign up with your nickname: one person will be drawn. No account needed.
drawStateNone: No draw is open right now. Come back during the stream.
drawStateClosed: Sign-ups for this draw are closed.
drawStateNoSite: This draw is played in the stream chat: type {keyword} in the chat to take part.
dm_closed: Sign-ups for this draw are closed.
dm_no_site: This draw is played in the stream chat, not from the site.
dm_already: You are already in: it is noted.
dm_muted: You cannot take part in this draw.
dm_full: This draw has reached its maximum number of people.
drawOvBoth: Type {keyword} in the chat or sign up on the site
